svg.title: Installs
svg.desc: Installs of jdx's tools through mise in the 30 days to Oct 6, CI excluded: mr boxington 3,359 (new), hk 61,452 (46% month over month), pitchfork 14,240 (11% month over month), fnox 41,856 (8% month over month), usage 49,255 (-9% month over month), aube 10,879 (-20% month over month). jdx tools combined 12% month over month, all of mise 11%.
